    """Calculates the value V for a given triple (x, y, z) and question (a, b, c)."""

    term2 = abs(y + z - b - c)

    return term1 + term2 + term3

]

]

            'target': (tx, ty, tz),
            'question': (aq, bq, cq),
            'V': V
